title: Generate a cited report and chart from supplied data
prompt: Using only the supplied dataset below, create a concise Markdown report comparing three fictional configurations. Include a table and a bar chart of median latency. State that these are illustrative measurements, not general model benchmarks. Do not browse or add external factual claims. Dataset: config Cedar: median latency 1.8 s, successful tasks 17/20; config Maple: median latency 2.4 s, successful tasks 18/20; config Birch: median latency 1.2 s, successful tasks 14/20. Explain the trade-off between latency and task success, and link the generated report and chart artifacts.
requested_dimensions: Latency table and chart use the supplied values
Success counts and denominators are preserved
Report and chart artifacts are generated and discoverable
acceptance_criteria: No supplied value is changed or silently recomputed incorrectly
The chart title, labels, units, and values are accurate
The output labels the dataset as illustrative
No unsupported external claim is introduced
Both artifact paths resolve to generated files
